title: GenerateExtendParams
description: Params of `generate.extend` (specs/09-generation.md §4.2): continue the song forward, or generate an intro backward. The rendered context audio is the job's `inputs.assets.context`; the backend requests `bars + overlapBars` bars so the gate pass can splice inside the overlap.

bars.description: Bars of new audio, not counting the overlap.

overlapBars.description: Bars of rendered context the model may re-create for the splice search (09 §4.2 step 2).

prompt.description: Optional user prompt. The planner/API rewrites artist names into descriptors before this point (specs/10-fusion.md §7).

seed.description: Optional base seed that overrides `context.seed`. An HQ re-render of an accepted candidate sends that candidate's `seed` with `tier: "hq"` and `n: 1`, so the background render starts from the same seed (09 §5).

ExtendDirection.description: `forward` continues the song at its end; `backward` generates an intro before its start (09 §4.2 step 5).

ExtendTier.description: Latency tier (09 §5): `preview` streams fast candidates, `hq` is the background re-render.
